papers.headline: Odd radio circle J1555+2726: Observational evidence for shock re-acceleration of fossil plasma
papers.summary: Context. Odd radio circles (ORCs) are peculiar extragalactic sources recently discovered. They are characterised by one or more bright rings extending on scales of hundreds of kiloparsecs, and are filled with fainter emission.
papers.title: Odd radio circle J1555+2726: Observational evidence for shock re-acceleration of fossil plasma

papers.headline: Sound-Horizon-Agnostic Forecast for Constraints on H₀ and Σm_ν from BAO, CMB Lensing, Supernovae and LSST-like Galaxy Lensing
papers.summary: We present a sound-horizon-agnostic forecast for constraints on the Hubble constant H₀ and the sum of the neutrino masses Σm_ν from a combination of LSST-like galaxy weak lensing, Simons-Observatory-like CMB lensing, the completed DESI BAO program, and expanded supernova samples.
papers.title: Sound-Horizon-Agnostic Forecast for Constraints on H₀ and Σm_ν from BAO, CMB Lensing, Supernovae and LSST-like Galaxy Lensing

papers.headline: Magnetic Activity as a Driver of Low-gravity-like Spectral Morphology in Late-M Dwarfs
papers.summary: We present a systematic investigation of the connection between magnetic activity and the low-surface-gravity-like near-infrared spectral morphology of late-M dwarfs.
papers.title: Magnetic Activity as a Driver of Low-gravity-like Spectral Morphology in Late-M Dwarfs
